question: As of 30 April 2020, who among the following was the Chairman of’ the Eastern Zonal Council?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amit Shah**__.

__
 
• **As of 30 April 2020, Amit Shah was the Chairman of the Eastern Zonal Council.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Zonal Councils:**

 
 
• The Zonal Councils are the **statutory bodies.**
 
• They are established by the **States Reorganisation Act of 1956**.
 
• The act divided the country into five zones i.e. **Northern, Central, Eastern, Western and Southern.**
 
• Each zonal council consists of the following members:
 
 
• The home minister of the Central government.
 
• Chief ministers of all the States in the zone.
 
• Two other ministers from each state in the zone.
 
• The Administrator of each union territory in the zone.
 
 
 
• The **Union Home Minister** is** ex-officio Chairman of the Zonal Councils.**
